kind: operator actions after the first debug run on the sixth trio — NOT agent decisions; excluded from every behavioural statistic
why: The run aborted after window 1 (the operator's external buyer and drain both reverted `transfer amount exceeds allowance`: the new WorkClaim had no USDC allowance from the operator).
